passage:
Near a river, a stone marker showed the height of a flood from long ago. Most people walked past without noticing it.
After a new flood warning project began, teachers brought students to see the marker. It was much higher than they expected.
The teacher explained that memory markers help communities remember risks after years of safety make people careless.
Students cleaned the area around the stone and added a sign explaining it.
The marker did not stop floods. It stopped forgetting.
A community that remembers past danger can prepare more wisely. History carved in stone can become a warning for people who never saw the water rise.
